title: Add independent HIP differential execution adapter
problem: HIP and chipStar share a launch API but need different compiler flag choices; a failed launch must not be mistaken for a formatting mismatch.
example:
--route hip uses hipcc with the selected ROCm offload architecture.
--route chipstar uses the externally selected HIP runtime.
Both check hipLaunchKernelGGL, the last launch error and device synchronization.
design: Use one handwritten HIP runtime adapter for the two compiler routes. Keep architecture selection on the native HIP route, and retain device properties and launch failures as separate evidence.
tradeoffs: The caller supplies the appropriate hipcc/runtime environment. Portable tests check source generation and flag overrides; they do not execute a HIP or chipStar kernel.
docs: Run the same case through a HIP kernel without a fmt device build. Execution requires the selected HIP or chipStar runtime and a device.
